subject: Provisioning assertions archive + min-privilege gap analysis
messages:
From: Aurelia Gomez <aurelia.gomez@fintrust.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
Cc: security@fintrust.com
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: FinTrust: request for SAML/SCIM/RBAC artifacts for SIG review

Hi Rohan,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG intake for the upcoming review we need a consolidated artifact bundle showing how Redwood handles provisioning and access control. Specifically we need: 
- SAML assertion samples (including NameID and attribute maps) for both interactive and service-user flows
- SCIM delta sample (create/update/delete events and change payloads) covering at least one tenant sync
- Export of RBAC roles and role-to-permission mappings (CSV or spreadsheet)
- Session/session-origin logs to show last-login and session duration sample
- Inventory of service accounts with justification and current owner (least-privilege attestation)
- A concise note that describes how you enforce least privilege across role assignment and service accounts

If you can provide timestamped samples and an RBAC export by EOD Friday, Dec 10, that would keep us on track for the SIG window. We can accept redacted artifacts. If anything is sensitive we can accept secure Drive links and an NDA-signed packet.

Thanks,
Aurelia
Aurelia Gomez
Senior Security Engineer | FinTrust Bank
security@fintrust.com

----

On Thu, 02 Dec 2026 at 16:05, rohan_mehta@redwood.ai wrote:
From: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
To: Aurelia Gomez <aurelia.gomez@fintrust.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinTrust: request for SAML/SCIM/RBAC artifacts for SIG review

Aurelia — thanks for the clear list. Naomi and Hannah, can you own collection and redaction? I want to deliver a single archive and a short 1-page memo describing mitigations and the min-priv policy.

Plan:
- Naomi: collect SAML assertion samples, SCIM delta, RBAC export (see checklist attached).
- Hannah: compile service-account inventory and produce the least-privilege attestation note; run quick gap analysis and flag items requiring owner action.
- I will review, redact anything sensitive, and push the Drive link to Aurelia by Dec 9.

Naomi/Hannah — if you hit blockers (P0 data, missing logs), call me and I will escalate to infra.

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta
Director, Security & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: fintrust-iam-checklist.csv (columns: artifact, location, owner, retention note)

----

On Fri, 03 Dec 2026 at 10:14, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai wrote:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinTrust: request for SAML/SCIM/RBAC artifacts for SIG review

Rohan — pulling together the initial bundle. Progress update: 
- SAML assertion samples: included (saml-assertions-samples.txt) — two login flows: federated SSO (IdP-initiated) and SP-initiated API key refresh. Attributes redacted for PII.
- SCIM delta sample: scim-delta-example.json (includes create and replace for two users, delete stub). Timestamps preserved.
- RBAC export: rbac-role-export.csv — covers 12 roles and permission mappings across API and Console.
- Session logs: we can deliver a 7-day extract limited to admin/non-admin buckets; still coordinating with logging infra for full login-origin traces.
- Drive link (internal): https://drive.redwood.local/Shared/FinTrust/iam-artifacts (permissions: fintrust-security@external)

Attachments: saml-assertions-samples.txt; scim-delta-example.json; rbac-role-export.csv

Open questions for Aurelia and team: 
1) For service-account inventory, do you want HSM / KMS key metadata included? We can summarize key IDs but not share access material.
2) Are redacted Assertion IDs acceptable or do you need full IDs for correlation with your IdP logs?

I will deliver a compiled zip and a one-page gap note by Dec 8 for internal review; then Rohan will push final to FinTrust.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Identity Engineer
Redwood Inference

----

On Tue, 09 Dec 2026 at 11:08, rohan_mehta@redwood.ai wrote:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Aurelia Gomez <aurelia.gomez@fintrust.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, security@fintrust.com
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinTrust: request for SAML/SCIM/RBAC artifacts for SIG review

Aurelia — attaching the compiled deliverables and our short gap analysis. Deliverables (attached and Drive link):
- saml-assertions-samples.txt (redacted identifiers)
- scim-delta-example.json
- rbac-role-export.csv
- service-account-inventory.xlsx (owner, last-used, justification)
- minpriv-gap-analysis-20261208.pdf (quick findings and POA)

Summary highlights:
- No evidence of over-privileged default roles in the last 90 days; the gap analysis flags 7 service accounts that do not have a documented owner — we provided recommended owners and a 30-day ownership remediation plan.
- SCIM deltas are consistent with tenant provisioning cadence; we included attribute mapping notes for your IdP.
- Session traces: we provided a 7-day extract; for expanded origin tracing we will coordinate with infra once the scope is approved (we flagged the required logs in the gap analysis).

Next steps:
- Please confirm if redacted assertion IDs are sufficient for your SIG correlation tests.
- If you need a live walkthrough we can schedule a 30-minute call; proposed slot Wed Dec 10 10:00am PT.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.local/Shared/FinTrust/iam-artifacts (access: granted to fintrust-security@external)
HubSpot ticket: https://hubspot.redwood/deal/FT-2026-SIG-77

Regards,
Rohan Mehta
Director, Security & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: saml-assertions-samples.txt; scim-delta-example.json; rbac-role-export.csv; service-account-inventory.xlsx; minpriv-gap-analysis-20261208.pdf
